ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modes of preservation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.
   B. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected verses has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

5. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions .
   D. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Ulul-Azm Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulul-Azm Prophets.
   C. Say Ulul-Azm Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Ulul-Azm Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in revealed scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in revealed scriptures has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Belief in revealed scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in revealed scriptures.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

11. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.
   B. Say Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T? (1 mark)
   A. Use Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T.
   D. Say Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

17. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
